response.text: {"statements":[{"statement":"The message \"Locked by Tallowbrook\" indicates a fraud lock.","reason":"The context explicitly says that if the app says the card is \"Locked by Tallowbrook\", fraud systems have placed a fraud lock on it.","verdict":1},{"statement":"The message \"Locked by Tallowbrook\" does not indicate a freeze.","reason":"The context says this is a fraud lock, different from a freeze the cardholder set, and explicitly says it is a fraud lock, not a freeze.","verdict":1},{"statement":"The freeze toggle cannot remove the fraud lock.","reason":"The context explicitly states that a fraud lock cannot be removed with the freeze switch.","verdict":1},{"statement":"If the app displays a fraud alert, the cardholder should respond to the fraud alert.","reason":"The context says to answer an open fraud alert in the app, and that tapping \"Yes, that was me\" usually removes the lock straight away.","verdict":1},{"statement":"If the app does not display a fraud alert, the cardholder should message support through the app.","reason":"The context instructs the cardholder to message support in the app if there is no alert.","verdict":1},{"statement":"App support can pass the cardholder's case to the Fraud team.","reason":"The context explicitly states that Support will pass the case to the Fraud team when the cardholder messages in the app without an alert.","verdict":1},{"statement":"The Fraud team replies within 2 business days.","reason":"The context says the Fraud team replies within 2 business days.","verdict":1},{"statement":"The Fraud team often replies sooner than 2 business days.","reason":"The context says the Fraud team replies within 2 business days, often much sooner.","verdict":1}]}
